text: Refti Men jippina lepte ɗen e maɓɓe, Men daɗnda Nulaaɓe Amen ɓen, men daɗndida e maɓɓe kadi ɓen gomɗimɓe. Huunde ko yanata e mofte maɓɓe ɗen hewtataa ɓe. Ko woni Men daɗndiri non ɓen Nulaaɓe e gomɗimɓe wonnduɓe e maɓɓe, Men daɗndirta Nulaaɗo Alla on e gomɗimɓe wonnduɓe e makko ɓen danndal jojjungal tabiti e Amen.
